snapshot.head: 40db54d5d5d54400b3f70f32795cab05da0f009b
snapshot.methodology: MCP graph discovery + javac semantic symbol binding (--release 25); framework dispatch manually classified
snapshot.scope: src/main/java only; includes nested/anonymous types, constructors and separately marked compiler-generated methods; excludes test helpers, dependencies and reflection/runtime dispatch expansion
limitations: Calls inside lambdas are attributed to their containing source method; a reference means callback registration, not immediate execution.
Virtual dispatch is bound to the statically declared target, not all possible runtime implementations.
Java call order, branches, transaction timing and framework dispatch are not determined by the graph alone.
Generated members and source initializers have no standalone source definition.
No incoming Java edge does not imply unused code.
